sources.entry: Menubar Colors - macOS app for convenient access to the system color panel.

summary.one_liner: Menubar Colors is a small OS X menubar utility that gives quick access to the system-wide color panel.
summary.what_it_does: The app sits in the macOS menubar and opens the system color panel with a click. Left-clicking the menubar icon toggles the color panel's visibility, and right-clicking opens a dropdown menu of options. The author chose the system color panel instead of building a custom picker, because the panel can be extended with plugins. The README lists three recommended color picker plugins: Skala Color, Antetype Color Picker, and Developer Color Picker. It can be installed from a release download or with a Homebrew Cask command.
use_cases: quick access to a color picker from the menubar
grabbing hex or color values while coding
opening the system color panel without digging through menus
how_to_run: Or download the latest release from the GitHub releases page
stack: Objective-C or Swift (macOS app, not stated in README)
notable: Uses the built-in macOS system color panel rather than a custom picker
Left click toggles the color panel; right click opens a menu
caveats: Only for macOS (README refers to OS X menubar)
Usefulness depends on system color panel; plugins are separate downloads
README gives no details on development status or maintenance
